correctness.rationale: The m distinct ordinary doubles on M exhaust its 2m incidences with the arrangement, so M contains no further marked points and contains the designated doubles. For an integral noncomponent curve C of degree e, the sum of intersections with the arrangement is 2me, at least the sum of r_P mult_P C, which is at least twice the sum of mult_P C. The strict bound on points per arrangement line excludes those components. If C attains 1/m, every term lost in the two inequalities is zero: all intersections with arrangement lines are supported at ordinary doubles, and the local multiplicity is exactly mult_P C. On each of the two designated lines this forces mult_P C=e at its sole double. If C differs from M, Bézout on M then gives e≥2e at the two distinct points. This argument applies in arbitrary characteristic and does not assume C is smooth. Exceptional curves have intersection 1 with D; for strict transforms the same bound gives nefness and the equality test gives the sole null curve. For the example D²=64−38=26 and nefness implies bigness; the transform of M has square 1−8=−7.
residual_risks: The finite calculation enumerates the 57 rational points and lines, giving 38 geometric marked points (all rational because obtained from rational lines), multiplicities 16/12/8/2, line counts 7 on 14 lines and 6 on two, and eight doubles on M. It recovers exactly the four single-double lines, their partners, and the sole eight-secant. The calculation does not test higher-degree uniqueness, which rests on the proof.
Only the stated sufficient conditions were tested; there is no necessity, semiampleness or contraction conclusion.

value.rationale: Which curves tie the threshold is a distinct problem from finding its value. The incidence criterion solves it for all degrees in every covered arrangement, without solving new polynomial incidence equations for possible competitors. In the motivated 38-point example it identifies the unique negative curve in the null locus of the specific big nef class, rather than simply rechecking a numerical counterexample.
residual_risks: The contribution is a conditional equality-case lemma and one application, not a new line arrangement, a new numerical threshold, or a description of the full nef cone.
